blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival announced Wednesday evening that classes at all levels in public schools here will remain suspended on Thursday as the latest Air Quality Index (AQI) readings reached 168 as of 6 p.m., which is classified as “Very Unhealthy.” Despite the continued suspension, Archival acknowledged the concerns of parents, students, educators, and business owners, recognizing how prolonged suspensions can disrupt learning and businesses that depend on school-related activities. “These concerns are valid, and we do not take them lightly,” he said, while noting that the government’s immediate priority is public health—especially the health of our children, […]...
